candidate_sentences.text: Trophy Games delivered a strong financial performance in 2025, driven by rapid scaling of its Transport Series and increased advertising monetisation.
Revenue rose 40% to DKK 126.5 million from DKK 90.1 million in 2024.
EBITDA increased 26% to DKK 31.1 million, although the EBITDA margin decreased to 25% from 27% as the company expanded marketing investment.
Profit before tax more than doubled to DKK 19.0 million, up 109%, while profit for the year increased to DKK 12.5 million from DKK 7.5 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: The 'Big 3' titles—Airline Manager, Truck Manager, and Farm Manager—collectively generated 67% of 2025 revenue (DKK 85m) and 65% of EBITDA, driven by Truck Manager's foundational scaling (revenue growth from DKK 1.2m in 2024 to DKK 25.2m in 2025) and Farm Manager's successful July 2025 launch with 5 million pre-registrations.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Progress & Results section (pages 13-20); Game Breakdown table (page 13); Truck Manager section (page 17); Farm Manager section (page 18)

candidate_sentences.text: Growth was concentrated in the three main Transport titles.
Airline Manager revenue increased 28% to DKK 37.8 million, while Truck Manager generated DKK 25.2 million compared with DKK 1.2 million in 2024 as it moved into its scaling phase.
Farm Manager, launched in July 2025, contributed DKK 22.0 million during its first six months.
Together, these “Big 3” titles generated DKK 85 million, or 67% of group revenue, and DKK 20 million of EBITDA, compared with 35% of revenue and 25% of EBITDA in 2024.

verified_key_information_units.information: Strategic ad revenue optimization initiated in late September 2025 boosted In-App Ads (IAA) revenue by 100% to DKK 18.5m, improving monetization efficiency by eliminating platform fees and increasing IAA's share of total revenue to 14.6% (2024: 10.2%).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Strategic Ad Revenue Optimisation section (pages 21-22); Financial Performance section (page 26)

candidate_sentences.text: In-app advertising revenue doubled to DKK 18.5 million and represented 14.6% of total revenue, compared with 10.2% in 2024.
The company began a phased advertising optimisation programme in late September, with further implementation planned through the second quarter of 2026.

verified_key_information_units.information: 2026 financial guidance targets revenue of DKK 130-153m (+3% to +21%) and EBITDA of DKK 28-36m, with strategic focus on optimizing the existing portfolio, disciplined investment in Train Manager 2 and Space Manager, and maintaining margin discipline amid regulatory uncertainty.

candidate_sentences.text: For 2026, management expects revenue of DKK 130–153 million, EBITDA of DKK 28–36 million and EBT of DKK 18–24 million, while continuing to invest in Truck Manager, Farm Manager, Train Manager 2 and Space Manager.

verified_key_information_units.information: Strong liquidity position with a 78% solvency ratio (2024: 86%), total equity of DKK 66.1m, and completion of a DKK 5m share buy-back program, reflecting a robust capital structure with no interest-bearing debt.

candidate_sentences.text: Year-end cash decreased 9% to DKK 23.0 million, while total equity increased to DKK 66.1 million.
The group had no interest-bearing external debt and maintained a 78% solvency ratio.

verified_key_information_units.information: Framework-driven development strategy enables cost-efficient title launches, portfolio-wide upgrades, and a competitive moat, as evidenced by reusable codebases and retrofitting features like staff management and stock markets across titles.

details.completeness_justification: K1–K5 are fully represented with the headline financials, Big 3 contribution, ad-revenue optimisation, 2026 guidance and liquidity metrics all captured. K6 (framework-driven development strategy and reusable codebases) is absent.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence builds logically on the previous ones: revenue and margin trends are explained by the same drivers (marketing spend, title performance), segment contributions are presented with clear percentages and comparisons, and forward-looking guidance follows directly from the 2025 results. No self-contradictions, logical gaps, or unnecessary repetitions are present.
